versions.name: RXV2-0.9.583-find-a-setting
versions.notes: NEW: Find a setting. A search box on the home page and the Rotorflight menu: type a word or two (head speed, cells, spool-up, arm, wiggle, bind...) and every matching setting is listed with the page and card it lives on. Tap one and the page opens with that setting glowing for a few seconds. The index is built from the pages themselves, so it always matches this receiver. Includes 0.9.580-0.9.582.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.582-backup-banks
versions.notes: Backup fix: 'the flight controller changed bank mid-backup' with the transmitter OFF. The receiver remembered the bank a phone last selected and quietly put the flight controller back on it before the next bank read, even when the phone had since asked the flight controller which bank it was on and started a fresh backup from there. The phone saw the move and gave up, leaving the flight controller on the wrong bank, so the next attempt failed the same way. Now a phone that reads the bank status is taken at its word. Includes 0.9.580 and 0.9.581.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.581-whole-seconds
versions.notes: On the V1 transmitter the governor timings (spool-up, spool-down, speed-change/tracking, recovery, throttle-hold and autorotation timeouts) are now WHOLE SECONDS: 4 means four seconds. Rotorflight keeps them in tenths, and the transmitter's plain numbers made 4 mean 0.4 s. A half-second value saved from the transmitter rounds to the nearest second. The phone pages were already in seconds. Also corrects the governor-mode help text (DIRECT = throttle passed through with the ramps, for an ESC that governs by itself). Includes 0.9.580: the flight-controller wire stays connected after a field flight with the transmitter off, and the cell count is read from the right byte.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.580-field-fixes
versions.notes: Two field fixes from the Goblin's first flight-test morning. (1) After a flight away from home WiFi, switching the transmitter off parked the flight-controller wire for the failsafe lamp while the phone was still connected over Bluetooth, so every Rotorflight read answered 'did not respond' until the receiver was rebooted. The wire now stays connected whenever Bluetooth config is up, and a phone request re-attaches it in any case. (2) The cell count read from Rotorflight was taken from the wrong byte (its battery STATE), which showed the 12S pack as '3S · 15 V/cell' on the Black box; the real count is read now. Also: the RealFlight controls page title no longer hides under the header buttons.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.579-back-trail
versions.notes: The back arrow now walks back through the last few pages you actually visited (up to six), instead of guessing the menu you came from. Going back pops the trail; a link that loops back to an earlier page shortens it.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.578-slider-help
versions.notes: Press and hold a slider's heading (Easy tuning, Governor, Rates, PIDs pages) to see exactly which numbers it moves and by how much; the Easy tuning help page lists them too.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.577-easy-tuning
versions.notes: New in À la carte: 'Easy tuning' - every plain-English slider in one place (how hard it starts, how agile, softer/sharper feel), a link under each to the page with the numbers, one Save that writes only what changed and verifies it. And the sliders now work backwards on the Governor, Rates and PIDs pages: type a number by hand and the slider moves to match.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.576-feel-sliders
versions.notes: Two more plain-English controls, numbers still visible underneath. Rates page: 'How agile?' - a Docile-to-Acrobatic slider sets the top rotation speeds (roll and pitch 120 to 500 deg/s, yaw 150 to 600) and a Soft-centre-to-Direct slider sets the expo on all three axes (Rotorflight rates type). PIDs page: 'Feel' - Cyclic and Tail sliders from softer to sharper scale this bank's P, I, D and feedforward together by up to 30 %, relative to what was loaded; wobbles or shakes = softer, sluggish or mushy = sharper; after a save the sliders return to centre.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.575-start-slider
versions.notes: Governor page: a slider 'How hard should it start?' from very gentle to very fierce sets spool-up time, handover throttle and startup time together (gentle = full head speed in 40 s with handover 10 %, fierce = 10 s and 25 %), and saving can switch PID spool-up on in every bank so the torque is even all the way up. The numbers stay visible underneath. Malcolm's idea, 2026-09-06.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.574-noreload
versions.notes: The PIDs, PID + and Rates pages lose their 'Reload from flight controller' button too (switching banks re-reads). The Governor (global) page keeps its one - it has no banks.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.573-gov-noreload
versions.notes: Governor profile page: the 'Reload from flight controller' button is gone (it sat under the Spool-up card and got hit by mistake); switching banks re-reads the bank anyway.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.572-arm-aux6
versions.notes: Arming channel learned from Rotorflight is now right: Rotorflight has five control channels, so its AUX1 is channel 6, not 5. Before this the receiver could pick the throttle channel as the arm switch, so 'armed' meant 'motor on' - radios went off with the motor and the landing wiggle came at motor-off while still armed. Check Receiver settings if you set the arming channel by hand.
